_meta.label: The Alliance DAO (aDAO)
_meta.summary: 10,000-NFT Terra collection whose contract holds an Alliance-module 'Ally' stake. Rewards are claimed daily, bonded to ampLUNA, and split 90% to unbroken holders / 10% to the DAO wallet. Holders may 'break' once to take their share.

facts.claim: The Alliance DAO collection is 10,000 NFTs on Terra (contract terra1phr9fngjv7a8an4dhmhd0u0f98wazxfnzccqtyheq4zqrrp4fpuqw3apw9).
facts.notes: Split, custody and marketplace counts are live in summary.json (unbroken_count, broken_count, unminted_count, treasury_held_count…).

facts.claim: The NFT contract earns LUNA staking rewards through the Terra Alliance module: its 'Ally' asset was admitted as an Alliance asset by Terra governance, so the contract's stake is rewarded alongside native LUNA delegations.
facts.notes: The exact reward share is set by the asset's Alliance reward_weight (query /terra/alliances). Not yet recorded here — do not quote a percentage for 'share of all staking rewards' until it is.

facts.claim: Once a day (around 00:50 UTC) Eris's auto-compound bot (terra1gtuvt6eh4m67tvd2dnfqhgks9ec6ff08c5vlup) calls alliance_claim_rewards on the NFT contract; all accrued LUNA rewards are claimed in one transaction.
Every LUNA claimed is bonded into the Eris staking hub in the same transaction, so rewards arrive as ampLUNA (which itself keeps compounding) rather than as liquid LUNA.

Of the ampLUNA minted by each daily claim, 90% stays in the NFT contract as backing shared by all unbroken NFTs and 10% is sent to the DAO main wallet (terra1sffd4efk2jpdt894r04qwmtjqrrjfc52tmj6vkzjxqhd8qqu2drs3m5vzm) as operating funds.
facts.source_section: decoded claim tx, 2026-04-25: 1,874 LUNA claimed → 899 ampLUNA → 809 holders pool + 89 DAO wallet
facts.notes: This 10% is the NFT contract's treasury cut. It is NOT the TLA 10% take rate on gauge rewards — two different mechanisms that share a number. Never say 'take rate' unqualified.

facts.claim: Backing per unbroken NFT is the contract's ampLUNA balance divided by the unbroken count; the contract's per-token rewards{} query matches this for unbroken tokens but is wrong for broken ones, so the site always uses the collection-wide division.
facts.notes: Daily history (ampLunaPerNft, ampLunaRate, backingInLuna per day) is nfts/adao/snapshots/backing-history.json rows[]. Daily gain = latest two rows' backingInLuna difference per day.

facts.claim: A holder may 'break' an NFT once: the NFT's share of the ampLUNA backing is paid out to the holder and that NFT stops accruing. The holder keeps the NFT and any governance voting power it carries; broken NFTs remain transferable.
Breaking is offered on BoostDAO Ignite and on Atrium; both support the same contract action.
The daily claim does not depend on how many NFTs are unbroken, so as NFTs break, the same 90% inflow is divided among fewer NFTs and per-NFT daily yield rises.
facts.source_section: The Last NFT Standing: Reward Projection Calculator

facts.claim: aDAO governs on DAODAO: a main DAO (terra1sffd4efk2jpdt894r04qwmtjqrrjfc52tmj6vkzjxqhd8qqu2drs3m5vzm) with an NFT-staking voting module (terra1c57ur376szdv8rtes6sa9nst4k536dynunksu8tx5zu4z5u3am6qmvqx47), plus a smaller Council DAO.

aDAO itself holds two direct TLA locks (max-duration ampLUNA and max-duration arbLUNA) and no Votion vault positions; its TLA-wide voting power is the treasury wallet as one entity, not the sum of members.
The Alliance rewards to the Ally asset are granted by Terra governance and can be changed or removed by a future proposal; they are not guaranteed.

The Ally asset (factory/terra1phr9fngjv7a8an4dhmhd0u0f98wazxfnzccqtyheq4zqrrp4fpuqw3apw9/AllianceNFT) is an Alliance asset on Terra with reward_weight 0.008 and take_rate 0, pinned (reward_weight_range min = max = 0.008, no decay). Admitted by Terra governance proposal #4801 (submitted 2024-02-16, passed 2024-02-23).
facts.source_section: MsgCreateAlliance in gov prop 4801 (org governance/props capture)
facts.notes: The forum draft proposed 0.003 (~0.29% of LUNA staking rewards); after Commonwealth feedback the author raised it to 0.008 on 2024-02-12 and that is what went on chain. Ally is minted and held solely by the NFT contract; it never leaves it. The resulting share of total LUNA staking rewards depends on all alliance weights at the time — quote the weight, not a percentage, unless computed from a live alliances read.

facts.claim: The collection rewarded Game of Alliance (GoA) participants: an incentivized testnet that battle-tested Terra's Alliance module from 2023-02-09 to 2023-03-02. The NFT launched 2023-12-12 with a one-month claim window to 2024-01-12; 1,191 NFTs were claimed free, and the 8,809 unclaimed were minted to the DAO's mint-era treasury (Enterprise DAO terra1g0mfrpswewteaf9ky4rlj09wh5njp6u9xxk94uszplw4qz2f9mzq3k27fm).
facts.source_section: README Background / Claim period; chain via nfts/adao/provenance
facts.notes: Minter terra1m3ye6dl6s25el4xd8adg9lnquz88az9lur2ujztj9pfmzdyfz3xsm699r3 (code 2325), collection terra1phr9… (code 2322). Audit report is in the repo. First free claim on chain 2023-12-12.

facts.claim: The AllianceDAO Growth Proposal (Notion, early 2024) allocated treasury NFTs in phases: 1a — 462 NFTs (rarity ≤ 10) to the council multisig, broken on receipt, as governance security; 1b — 385 to Jan-12-2024 stakers (33 addresses with 2+ staked got assigned rarities 20–40 via escrow at 50 LUNA; 352 single-stakers a random mint at 50 LUNA); 2a — 900 planned for Galactic Punks / Skeleton Punks / PixeLions holders at 75 LUNA; 2b — 1,300 to the Terra and Alliance communities at 100 LUNA. Unclaimed allocations return to the treasury.
facts.notes: This is the PLAN. What happened on chain is adao.history.mint_story (2a loaded 1,000 not 900; 2b ran as three priced rounds 100/115/130).

facts.claim: Chain-exact distribution (FCD archive, complete to 2025-01-07): 1,191 free GoA claims; 127 sold at 50 LUNA (Phase 1b, 2024-02-20→03-04, 352 loaded, 225 returned to treasury); 525 sold at 75 LUNA (Phase 2a, 2024-02-28→03-18, 1,000 loaded, 473 returned, 2 moved by governance); 1,300 sold in Phase 2b (2024-06-01→06-05) as 197 at 100 + 459 at 115 + 644 at 130 LUNA = 156,205 LUNA. Paid mints total 1,952; primary proceeds 201,930 LUNA (≈$135,451 at each token's mint-day LUNA price).
facts.source_section: summary.json mint_story + distribution_reconciliation (loaded = sold + returned + governance moves, per candy machine)
facts.notes: Candy machines: terra182fvr6f…sp0g98h (50), terra17tg0lk3…xyj09c (75), terra1jw84ef5…sxfte89 (100/115/130). USD per phase at mint-day LUNA: 1b avg $34.24, 2a avg $54.62, 2b avg $78.79 (2b weighted average price 120.16 LUNA). The site's release-history page is gated against these numbers.

facts.claim: 1,000 treasury NFTs were sent to the council multisig (terra1h8psjgcsg9fef7w2yv0j6262sfcaszj8vs4tsy3uwla6zwtaspvqrp4l7v) and broken on receipt as governance security: 462 in February 2024 (Growth Proposal 1a) and 538 in June 2024 (props 64–69, after the Phase 2b mint). Chain break counts: 462 in 2024-02, 539 in 2024-06.
facts.source_section: treasury→multisig transfers by month; breaks by month
facts.notes: Broken NFTs still vote in governance; they no longer accrue backing. Live custody today: 898 broken at the multisig, 100 at the Enterprise DAO stake, 2 at the DAO wallet — the 1,000. Lifetime breaks were 1,010 at the archive freeze (2025-01-07) and 1,093 live on 2026-08-24.
